records.unavailable_fact: released text does not define every empty-pool/full-inventory combination
known_released_facts: an illegal candidate cannot be selected
rejected choices must not mutate authoritative state
records.selected_policy: emit a ReferenceOnly no-candidate outcome, consume no inventory resource and continue at the next declared lifecycle boundary
rejected_alternatives: silently replace or downgrade an owned maximum-level item
records.rationale: bounded explicit failure preserves state and avoids nontermination
records.replacement_condition: replace when released structured logic or reproducible observation defines each empty-candidate branch

records.unavailable_fact: released sources do not fully specify whether every just-rejected candidate remains eligible after refresh
known_released_facts: refresh generates a new legal offer
maximum-level and profile-ineligible records remain illegal
records.selected_policy: exclude the immediately displayed candidate IDs for one refresh attempt, then fall back to the full legal pool if exclusion would empty it
rejected_alternatives: allow the identical offer without an explicit fallback
permanently exclude every previously seen candidate for the battle
records.rationale: one-attempt exclusion makes refresh meaningful while the bounded fallback prevents an artificial dead end
records.replacement_condition: replace when released logic or reproducible observations define refresh exclusion memory and fallback

records.unavailable_fact: released score displays do not expose every intermediate rounding boundary
known_released_facts: final displayed scores and exact structured thresholds are integers
authoritative arithmetic cannot use binary floats
records.selected_policy: retain canonical fixed-point intermediates and round toward zero only at each explicitly authored integer score contribution boundary
records.rationale: named contribution boundaries minimize invented rounding while producing deterministic integer totals
records.replacement_condition: replace when released formula programs or exact observations identify the authoritative rounding boundary and mode

choose an eligible recipe using an unlabeled random draw

records.replacement_condition: replace when released program evidence or a reproducible observation proves the exact simultaneous resolution order
